BiblicalUsage: Once, in Proverbs 27:4: Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy? The word is cruelty itself — the abstract noun, fierceness as a quality.
TheologicalSignificance: One verse, one proverb, and the word itself carries little weight; its weight is the ranking, that envy outlasts wrath and anger and stands when the loud sins have spent themselves.
